newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR RELUCTANT TO STIR, AWAITS NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR RELUCTANT TO STIR, AWAITS NY.

text.p: White sugar futures barely stirred on Tuesday morning and the London market was content to hold steady after the recent supportive buying from trade players, market sources said.
Benchmark October opened at the $323.00 high of the previous session, reached after trade buying offset an initial bout of speculator selling.
But on Tuesday the market was reluctant to stray too far from the open with traders expecting little activity before the New York open.
Volume was confined to a thin 177 lots by 1135 GMT. October was up 10 cents at $323.00 in a tight range of just 50 cents. December was down by the same amount at $320.80.

Technical analysts said if $320 was confirmed as the low of the recent price action, the bull trend would have remained intact and prices could now climb higher for a test of $325 followed by $330 and $331.
Paris was equally lacklustre with 149 lots on the board. October was up 70 cents at $323.00, the same as its London equivalent, while December was unchanged at $319.80.
